intro: Lithuania has a growing high-tech economy known for lasers, fintech and life sciences.

chapters.title: Lasers and fintech
text: Lithuanian companies make a large share of the world's scientific lasers. Vilnius has become a hub for financial technology firms, and biotech is growing fast.

chapters.title: Ports and farms
text: Klaipėda is an ice-free Baltic port, and farming, food processing and furniture-making are important. Lithuania uses the euro.

keyTerms.meaning: Technology used to provide financial services, such as payment apps.
